cli.description: Fulogin Nagios don duba farashin Bitcoin
cli.epilog:
Misalai:
  %(prog)s
    Duba farashin Bitcoin ba tare da iyaka ba (farashi mai inganci yana dawo da OK)

  %(prog)s -w 30000:50000 -c 25000:60000
    Gargaɗi idan farashi yana ƙasa da 30000 ko sama da 50000
    Mummunan gargaɗi idan farashi yana ƙasa da 25000 ko sama da 60000

  %(prog)s --warning-low 30000 --critical-low 25000
    Bayar da sanarwa kan faɗuwar farashi kawai

  %(prog)s --currency eur
    Duba farashi a EUR maimakon USD
